decisions.decision: The board asked for a new draft of the COA Board Member Orientation Packet to be printed reflecting the changes it made.
decisions.quote: the board made several changes to the latest document, and asked for a new draft to be printed reflecting those changes.

decisions.decision: Staff (Mr. Ruth) to contact engineers to draw up new plans for additional parking; a new parking lot to be requested for a future capital plan.
decisions.quote: mr. ruth will be in contact with engineers to draw up new plans for additional parking.

budget_items.topic: Senior tax relief: circuit breaker match cap
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town would match the circuit breaker tax credit, capped at no more than $1,200 per the article as described.
budget_items.quote: the town will match the amount of the circuit breaker tax credit, which should be no more than $1,200.

budget_items.topic: Senior tax relief: maximum relief amount
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Relief would max out at $300,000, described as 1 percent of the levy.
budget_items.quote: mr. franco went on to explain that the relief will max out at $300,000 (1 percent of the levy).

budget_items.topic: Senior tax relief: cost per household
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The relief is estimated to cost approximately $50-$60 per household per year, funded from property taxes of those not eligible.
budget_items.quote: which has been estimated to cost approximately $50-$60 per household per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A town warrant article would spend $5,000 on the 300th celebration.
budget_items.quote: there is an article on the town warrant to spend $5,000 on the celebration.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House Supporters June raffle calendar
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The goal is to sell 300 calendars, which would bring in $3,000 if achieved.
budget_items.quote: the goal has been set to sell 300 calendars, which would bring in $3,000 if achieved.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A bid package for the patio project will be published; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: mr. ruth reported that a bid package for the patio project will soon be published.

topics.quote: mr. lincoln motioned to approve the minutes from the march 22, 2023 meeting. ms. digiacomo seconded. on vote, motion carried unanimously.

topics.topic: Announcements: terms, new Facilities Manager, senior tax relief article
topics.quote: ms. lincoln introduced new facilities manager chris ruth.
ms. doherty has drafted an informational post card with the new lunenburg adult activity center logo to send out to residents.

topics.topic: Warrant article for May Town Meeting: senior tax relief
topics.quote: ms. lincoln wants the board to be informed about the senior tax relief article so they can help people understand.

topics.resolution: continued; new draft to be printed
topics.quote: the board made several changes to the latest document, and asked for a new draft to be printed reflecting those changes.
all but one have established their new town email accounts.
ms. lincoln informed the board that the 300th celebration committee will be meeting soon to brainstorm ideas.

topics.topic: Director's report: capital plan, building and grounds
topics.quote: mr. ruth reported that a bid package for the patio project will soon be published.
ms. talley reported that the supporters have collected 792 bags for their clothing drive fundraiser.
ms. lincoln reminded the board that there will be one vacancy on the board come july 1.
mr. lincoln motioned to adjourn, ms. digiacomo seconded. on vote, motion carried unanimously.
